## Asset Disposition

| Classification | Count | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `preserve` | 2 | Retain as an independent contract or currently qualified control-plane asset. |
| `requalify` | 12 | Keep the canonical implementation and obtain current Blueprint evidence. |
| `replace` | 0 | Rewrite the canonical implementation in place after defect evidence. |
| `remove` | 0 | Delete an obsolete or duplicate asset after absence evidence. |

Historical V1 acceptance is evidence input, not automatic current
qualification. No product implementation is deleted by this baseline.
